patches.reason: Remove Electron-only dev tooling (electron, @lydell/node-pty, devtools-protocol) from devDependencies. They are used only by gui-extensions' own tests/typecheck, and electron's postinstall pulls ~110MB of binaries that the web build never needs.
patches.verification: V2 (bun run build:web) succeeds without the removed devDependencies.
patches.rebase: S3 exercise: regenerated at b4525d79bf (upstream bumped electron 44.4.5->44.9.1 in the devDependencies block; same three removals, context lines updated; no semantic change).

patches.reason: Memory-only credentials: the encode (write) path of the server persistence schema drops `password`, so no persistent backend (web localStorage, desktop storage, drafts) ever receives one. Decoding still tolerates stored passwords from legacy files; a missing password reaches the existing authentication-failure path. Keystore persistence is owned by mobile issue #4. The embedded marker string 'mobile(M-002): password stripped at encode (memory-only)' survives minification and anchors V-cred dist verification.
patches.verification: V-cred: (a) encode-path strip present in source with marker; (b) marker string found in built dist assets; semantic probe of the codec against effect@4.0.1 confirmed strip on encode, tolerance on decode.
patches.rebase: S3 exercise: no rebase needed - packages/app/src/runtime/server/persistence.ts is unchanged at b4525d79bf; the patch applies verbatim.

patches.reason: Strip the three workspace references that dangle after closure acquisition (their targets are excluded packages): client devDependency @opencode/httpapi-codegen (generated code is committed), plugin devDependency+peerDependency+peerDependenciesMeta @opencode/theme (not in the runtime closure), ai devDependency @opencode/http-recorder (test recording tool). Bun 1.4.2 hard-errors on dangling workspace devDependencies and unsatisfied workspace peerDependencies.
patches.verification: V1 (bun install) succeeds and V3(b) workspace-reference scan reports zero dangling refs.
patches.rebase: S3 exercise: regenerated at b4525d79bf (the three target package.json files shifted line numbers upstream; all three dangling refs still present with identical semantics; hunks re-derived, no semantic change).

patches.reason: Build-time seam so the vendored app can import the first-party host registry (@opencode-mobile/mobile-hosts, issue #3). The alias value is expressed as fileURLToPath(new URL("../../../../packages/mobile-hosts/src/index.ts", import.meta.url)) - importer-relative like the existing fonts-cjk stub, so the four .. segments land on the repository root's packages/; a bare relative string would resolve against the importer and miss. Dependency direction stays one-way: the vendored packages themselves do not depend on the first-party package; only this alias resolves the specifier at build time.
patches.verification: V3 (verify-closure) tree equivalence with the patch registered; V2 build smoke after applying: `bun run build:web` succeeds and the built entry chunk resolves the mobile-hosts modules (no unresolved import errors).
patches.rebase: New patch (issue #3); rebase target is the resolve.alias block in packages/app/vite.js.

patches.reason: Adds an optional non-secret credential REFERENCE (http.credentialRef, inside ServerHttpBase) so a stored direct server can point at a keystore entry without storing any credential. The M-002 encode path still strips password; the reference is a pointer (mobile-credential:<id>), safe for every persistent backend, and resolves per session into memory only. Keystore-backed resolution is mobile issue #4; decoding tolerates absence for already-stored servers.
patches.verification: V3 tree equivalence with the patch registered; targeted probe scripts/verify-credential-ref.ts (schema round-trip keeps the reference, still strips password) plus the upstream persistence.test.ts file as regression.
patches.rebase: New patch (issue #3); rebase target is the ServerHttpBase struct in packages/app/src/runtime/server/persistence.ts, directly below the M-002 MemoryOnlyPassword field. Review note (issue #3, round 2): clearing semantics are 'undefined keeps, empty string clears' in the first-party registry (packages/mobile-hosts/src/registry.ts); whether a changed host target/identity invalidates or re-confirms its credentialRef is an issue #4 boundary decision, deliberately out of scope here.

patches.reason: The connect dialog constructs a fresh connection object on save; without this patch the M-005 credential reference would be dropped on the first edit of a server (both the same-url add path and the key-changing replace path). The original's reference is forwarded into the new connection; the form never edits it (it is a non-secret pointer, there is no reference input in the dialog). The 'nothing changed' early-exit comparison deliberately stays without the reference: it is never user-editable here, so it cannot be the only change, and adding it would keep the dialog open pointlessly.
patches.verification: scripts/verify-credential-ref.ts (schema round-trip keeps credentialRef + password still stripped + dialog forwards original.http.credentialRef and keeps it out of the early-exit comparison); upstream persistence.test.ts targeted run unchanged vs the M-002 baseline (same 4 pass / 1 pre-existing M-002 round-trip expectation).
patches.rebase: New patch (issue #3); rebase target is the request.mutationFn connection construction block in packages/app/src/servers/connect/dialog.tsx.

patches.reason: Shell bootstrap (issue #3). (1) Removes the assembly of location.origin into a ServerConnection: in this Android WebView shell the asset origin http://127.0.0.1:18090 is a static asset server, not an OpenCode service, so that connection could only fail its health check. The ?auth_token URL passthrough is inapplicable for the same reason (no assembled server to authenticate) and is removed with its cleanup helper. (2) Bootstraps the first-party host registry via createMobileHosts (fail-closed host-key stub + Null credential resolver; real counterparts are issues #6/#4) and injects hosts.upstreamConnections() - a solid-store-derived reactive value - as the app's servers prop; direct servers are added through the app's own dialog into the upstream persisted list. Not implemented via the VITE_OPENCODE_SERVER_MODE=none build-time variable on purpose: that would hide the behavior behind build configuration and complicate rebasing; this patch keeps the change visible and rebaseable in one place.
patches.verification: V2 build smoke after applying: bun run build:web succeeds and the built entry chunk contains the mobile-hosts bootstrap (dist marker mobile-ssh / opencode-mobile.hosts.v1). Runtime behavior on device is BLOCKED (G1/G13).
patches.rebase: New patch (issue #3); rebase target is the render block of packages/app/src/entry.tsx.

patches.reason: Mounts the first-party SSH host manager (lazy import) in the settings 'servers' tab, above the upstream single-server panel and also when the upstream list is empty, so the first SSH host can be created. The manager reads the runtime bootstrapped by M-007 through getMobileHosts(). Known gap, documented in docs/design/interaction.md: in the multiple-servers layout the upstream nav replaces the 'servers' tab with per-server entries, so the manager is not reachable there; the injected extension rows themselves render through the upstream home/settings inventory (device verification: G13/G15).
patches.verification: V2 build smoke (bun run build:web) with the lazy chunk resolving through the M-004 alias; manager rendering and interactions on device are BLOCKED (G13).
patches.rebase: New patch (issue #3); rebase targets are the lazy-import block after GuiExtensionsSettings and the 'servers' Tabs.Content block in packages/app/src/settings/shell.tsx.

patches.reason: Optional 'remember credential' for the connect dialog's password method (issue #4). The checkbox participates only when rendered AND the shell vault is available; the decision itself (truth table v3, 12 rows) lives in the first-party package (packages/mobile-hosts src/vault/remember.ts) so it is unit-tested and probe-able, and this patch only translates it into vault put/remove calls and the constructed connection. Add flow resolves the ref-bearing prior by normalized URL from server.list regardless of the connect method (password AND link/redeem) - otherwise the M-006 original is undefined on add and re-adding a remembered server would orphan its reference. Rows 2/12 abort the save with an inline needs-password message (never cast an empty value); the early-exit is forced off when the checkbox state differs from the prior's remembered flag; a failed put/remove keeps the dialog open with an inline error. Vault unavailable renders the checkbox disabled plus an explicit-state note - no plaintext fallback anywhere.
patches.verification: V3 tree equivalence with the patch registered; bun test truth-table suite (packages/mobile-hosts); scripts/verify-credential-vault.ts probes rows 1-12 + early-exit forcing + initial value through the in-process vault engine; V2 build smoke after registration.
patches.rebase: New patch (issue #4); rebase targets are the request.mutationFn block, the form controller state exports, the password-method JSX block, and the dialog.server i18n sections in packages/app/src/servers/connect/dialog.tsx.
